wires.label: C10 ↔ C4 — enable the channel we use
wires.desc: C10–D10 and C4–D4 put chip pins 1 and 7 at ground: channel 1 enabled.

wires.label: B4 → KB2040 G — shared ground
wires.desc: The wire at B4 joins the entire ground network to G on the KB2040.

wires.label: H10 → KB2040 RAW — power supply
wires.desc: RAW supplies power to H10, then G10 (chip pin 14) and I10 (LED power).

wires.label: KB2040 MO → C9 — color instructions
wires.desc: MO sends 3.3V data through C9–D9 to chip pin 2; this wire does not power the LED.

wires.label: A12 → LED DIN — translated instructions
wires.desc: Chip pin 3 at D8 → B8 → 330 Ω resistor → B12 → A12 → LED DIN.

wires.label: A4 → LED GND — LED ground
wires.desc: The LED ground wire at A4 joins B4 and the KB2040 ground.

wires.label: I10 → LED 5V — LED power
wires.desc: The LED gets power through I10–H10 from RAW, separately from its data wire.

wires.label: C6 ↔ B5 — hold unused input steady
wires.desc: C6–D6 grounds chip pin 5 through B5–B4.

wires.label: H5 ↔ H8 — join two unused inputs
wires.desc: H5–G5 and H8–G8 join chip input pins 9 and 12.

wires.label: I5 ↔ A5 — ground those inputs
wires.desc: I5–H5 connects that input pair to A5–A4 and the shared ground.

wires.label: H6 ↔ H9 — join two disable controls
wires.desc: H6–G6 and H9–G9 join enable pins 10 and 13; 5V switches these channels off.

wires.label: I9 ↔ J10 — switch two channels off
wires.desc: I9–H9 puts the enable pair on 5V through J10–I10.

wires.label: C7 ↔ K10 — switch last unused channel off
wires.desc: C7–D7 puts enable pin 4 on 5V through K10–J10.

wires.label: Knob ground → A3 — shared ground junction
wires.desc: The wire formerly in KB2040 G now goes to A3–A4; B4 provides its route back to KB2040 G.
